skill.name: code-context-finder
skill.description: Find relevant code context by combining knowledge graph lookup with local code relationship analysis before edits, debugging, or refactoring.
skill.summary: Surfaces prior decisions, related entities, dependencies, callers, and tests for safer code changes.
skill.author: Joseph OBrien

content.value_statement: Developers lose time when code relationships and prior decisions are hard to find. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to search knowledge graph context and code dependencies before changes.
actual_capabilities: Detects when unfamiliar files, shared modules, debugging, refactoring, or architecture work need more context.
Suggests MCP memory searches for project context, prior decisions, related concepts, and ownership signals.
Provides search patterns for imports, callers, implementations, tests, configuration references, APIs, and database queries.
Includes a Python helper script that analyzes imports, dependents, callers, and related tests for Python targets.
Formats findings as concise dependency reports and impact analysis summaries.
limitations: The helper script focuses on Python files and uses heuristic regular expression matching.
Knowledge graph results depend on available MCP memory data and its freshness.
Search patterns may miss dynamic imports, generated code, or framework-specific conventions.
The skill provides investigation guidance, not a complete static analysis engine.

use_cases.title: Assess Refactor Impact
use_cases.description: Find importers, callers, and related tests before changing a shared Python module.

use_cases.title: Recover Project Context
use_cases.description: Use memory search and relationship checks to understand why a module exists and how it is used.

use_cases.title: Support Architecture Decisions
use_cases.description: Retrieve prior decisions, similar implementations, and dependent components before selecting a design path.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup for an unfamiliar file
prompt_templates.prompt: Use code-context-finder to summarize the purpose, likely dependencies, and related memory context for this file: [file path].

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Bug Path
prompt_templates.prompt: Use code-context-finder to find related errors, affected components, callers, and tests for this failing area: [module or function].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: Use code-context-finder to map direct dependents, indirect impact, test coverage, and prior decisions before refactoring: [target].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Architecture Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use code-context-finder to combine knowledge graph decisions, similar implementations, owners, and code relationships for this architecture question: [question].

output_examples.input: Find context for the authentication service before changing its token validation flow.
output_examples.output: The result identifies key dependencies, files that import the service, related tests, and memory entries about past authentication decisions.

output_examples.input: Prepare an impact analysis for renaming a shared helper function.
output_examples.output: The result lists direct callers, likely indirect consumers, affected test areas, and suggested files to review before editing.

output_examples.input: Explain why this configuration module matters to deployments.
output_examples.output: The result combines deployment-related memory notes with code references that show where the configuration values are used.

best_practices: Start with the exact file, module, function, or feature name to keep searches focused.
Verify important matches by opening the referenced files before making edits.
Update memory with important new decisions or patterns after significant changes.
anti_patterns: Do not assume the first search result is authoritative without checking nearby code.
Do not run broad searches across unrelated directories when a narrower target is available.
Do not include secrets from configuration files in summaries or memory notes.

faq.question: What does this skill help me find?
faq.answer: It helps find prior decisions, related knowledge graph entries, imports, callers, dependents, and tests for code changes.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require MCP memory tools?
faq.answer: MCP memory tools improve knowledge graph results, but code relationship searches can still provide local context.

faq.question: Which languages are best supported?
faq.answer: The helper script is focused on Python. The reference patterns also include TypeScript, JavaScript, and cross-language searches.

faq.question: Can it replace code review?
faq.answer: No. It prepares context for safer edits, but humans and project tests still need to verify behavior.

faq.question: How should I handle configuration files?
faq.answer: Use configuration references to understand impact, but avoid copying secrets or sensitive values into summaries.
